description: A completed load's output: what it bound, a skill's manual and methods, and the calls it adds to the turn. A skill's load binds the method it names, or the skill's only method; one that binds none is a reading of the skill, which binds no closure and so asks no trust.

connectors.description: Each connector what it bound reaches, at the exact manifest and implementation it binds: a later load that binds another revision of a name is refused, and the project's own reaching a connector the turn does not already reach at that implementation waits on trust.

manual.description: A loaded skill's manual; none for a connector.

methods.description: Every method of a loaded skill, as a model chooses one, and whether this load bound it.

projects.description: Each skill package of the person's own it bound, `project:<name>`, at its directory: a later load in the run that binds another directory as the same `project:<name>` is refused, since the two would be one package.

tools.description: One per bound method, or per operation of a loaded connector, as the turn offers it from then on.

title: TurnLoad
